cast.title: RIDE THE TIGER
cast.overview: Three videos from Noel Gallagher's High Flying Birds directed by Mike Bruce and Blake West cut together as one short.

cast.title: Spinning Gold
cast.overview: A biopic of 1970s record producer Neil Bogart, co-founder of Casablanca Records.

cast.title: A Maple Valley Christmas
cast.overview: Erica is a rancher who has spent her whole life working the family farm with her mother and sister. When Aaron arrives and disrupts her plans, she starts to question what it is she actually wants.

cast.title: The Greatest Game Ever Played
cast.overview: A biopic of 20-year-old Francis Ouimet who defeated his golfing idol and 1900 US Open Champion, Harry Vardon.

cast.title: Meeting Evil
cast.overview: Follows disillusioned young family man John as a mysterious stranger, Richie takes him on a murder-fueled ride that transforms the weak-willed John into a desperate hero willing to go to any length to protect his family.

cast.title: Deep Winter
cast.overview: Maverick downhill racer, Tyler Crowe, reunites with best friend and renegade snowboarder, Mark Rider. It doesn't take long for the old friends to take on a new mission. Together they head to Alaska, where led by a veteran guide, the two attempt the most daring descent on snow ever caught on film. But with glory comes risk. And this challenge is no exception.

cast.title: Shuttle
cast.overview: When two friends return from a girls weekend vacation in Mexico, they find themselves stranded at the airport. Trying to get home safely, they board an airport shuttle for the short trip. But once their feet cross the threshold of the shuttle, a night that had started like any other turns terrifying, and the ride home becomes a descent into darkness.

cast.title: Batman: Hush
cast.overview: A mysterious new villain known only as Hush uses a gallery of villains to destroy Batman's crime-fighting career as well as Bruce Wayne's personal life, which has been further complicated by a relationship with Selina Kyle/Catwoman.
